title: Announcing "Vibe Coaster": A Massive Realistic Theme Park Game
author: vibecoaster
selftext:
When you have a dream, just make it! This game is one that I have wanted since I was a kid. In fact, I tried it 20 years ago at 8 years old using Game Maker... Back in April, I began making a new amusement park builder and it started in 2D. Months of progress, changes, a complete reverse in direction... And here we go! 

Vibe Coaster is not only about building and managing parks, but actual amusement park history from the trolley-park era to modern day, detail, and deep customization.

comments.author: crackedpotstudio
comments.body: So basically a planet coaster clone?

replies.author: alcarcalimo1950
replies.body: There is a lot of room for improvement in planet coaster. Coaster simulation is great. Park management and simulation of running an actual theme park?  Not so much

replies.author: crackedpotstudio
replies.body: Both features you’re talking about aren’t even covered in the trailer?

replies.author: alcarcalimo1950
replies.body: Not the point. I’m just saying “planet coaster clone” is reductive.

replies.author: vibecoaster
replies.body:
Completely different tone. PC is an awesome game, but is made to be like the Florida theme parks - not so much your everyday amusement park. 

Vibe Coaster ships with 100+ flat rides inspired from real rides from 100+ years of amusement engineering; over two dozen -- and counting themes are in the game with the ability to build complete structures in seconds. Full restaurants and gift shops can be placed and function in your park beyond 'stalls'.  
  
The economy modes in this game caters to how your park makes money. Are you a traditional 'ticket' park, do you include all day ride passes - or can you buy a season pass.

Also - the reality is that I'm a guy who really loves amusement parks and if you really came up to me and said "Your game is missing this ride, I remember it here and... you didn't include it"... I would get pretty intrigued and probably just do it... as an update.

replies.author: vibecoaster
replies.body:
Build, manage, and share your parks. Manage functioning your park in a genuine economy beyond just rides into food and retail - which goes into stalls but also actual restaurants and shops. 

This is still an early view of the game. Outside of winning a scenario or maintaining profit in economy mode, you can share parks, rides, coasters - everything individualized easily.

replies.author: vibecoaster
replies.body:
You'd be surprised how many names are trademarked. The original 2D prototype of this game was called "Isometricland". It was considered calling the game "Luna Park" as that was such a name for amusement parks! (But even though it's famous, it was figured... who knows too much about that place now?)

But Vibe Coaster.... The term came after the game idea and I really liked it!!
